feedback_scores.name: feedback_scores
feedback_scores.value:
("feedback"."overall" is null or "feedback"."overall" between 1 and 10)
    and ("feedback"."structure" is null or "feedback"."structure" between 1 and 10)
    and ("feedback"."clarity" is null or "feedback"."clarity" between 1 and 10)
    and ("feedback"."word_choice" is null or "feedback"."word_choice" between 1 and 10)
    and ("feedback"."pace_pausing" is null or "feedback"."pace_pausing" between 1 and 10)
    and ("feedback"."flow" is null or "feedback"."flow" between 1 and 10)
    and ("feedback"."presence" is null or "feedback"."presence" between 1 and 10)

feedback_rates.name: feedback_rates
feedback_rates.value:
("feedback"."pace_wpm" is null or "feedback"."pace_wpm" >= 0)
    and ("feedback"."fillers_per_min" is null or "feedback"."fillers_per_min" >= 0)

followup_score_provenance.name: followup_score_provenance
followup_score_provenance.value: "followup_attempts"."score" is null or length(trim("followup_attempts"."score_rubric_version")) > 0 and "followup_attempts"."score_rubric_version" is not null

confidence_before_range.name: confidence_before_range
confidence_before_range.value: "confidence_ratings"."before_confidence" is null or (typeof("confidence_ratings"."before_confidence") = 'integer' and "confidence_ratings"."before_confidence" between 1 and 5)

confidence_after_range.name: confidence_after_range
confidence_after_range.value: "confidence_ratings"."after_confidence" is null or (typeof("confidence_ratings"."after_confidence") = 'integer' and "confidence_ratings"."after_confidence" between 1 and 5)

confidence_live_q_range.name: confidence_live_q_range
confidence_live_q_range.value: "confidence_ratings"."after_live_q_confidence" is null or (typeof("confidence_ratings"."after_live_q_confidence") = 'integer' and "confidence_ratings"."after_live_q_confidence" between 1 and 5)

confidence_after_take.name: confidence_after_take
confidence_after_take.value: "confidence_ratings"."after_confidence" is null or "confidence_ratings"."after_take_id" is not null

confidence_live_q_attempt.name: confidence_live_q_attempt
confidence_live_q_attempt.value: "confidence_ratings"."after_live_q_confidence" is null or "confidence_ratings"."followup_attempt_id" is not null

diary_mood.name: diary_mood
diary_mood.value: "diary"."mood" is null or (typeof("diary"."mood") = 'integer' and "diary"."mood" between 1 and 5)
